title: How To Completely Reinvent Yourself In 6-12 Months

sentences.en: At some point, usually in your 20s, you'll notice that the people around you stop believing in themselves, and no matter how hard you try, you can't save them.
sentences.zh: 在人生的某个阶段，通常是二十多岁的时候，你会注意到身边的人不再相信自己，而无论你怎么努力，你都救不了他们。

sentences.en: By all means, do not let it infect your mind.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，别让这种想法侵蚀你的大脑。

sentences.en: Stay on your path.
sentences.zh: 走你自己的路。

sentences.en: So, as mulling over that thought for the past few days, and the more I think about it, the deeper the problem goes.
sentences.zh: 过去几天我一直在琢磨这个想法，越想越觉得问题比表面看起来深得多。

sentences.en: I can't help but notice that people between the ages of 20 and 35 just get trapped in this vicious cycle.
sentences.zh: 我无法不注意到，20到35岁之间的人，就这么被困在一个恶性循环里。

sentences.en: You get motivated by some external source, a video, a book, a conversation, whatever.
sentences.zh: 你被某个外部来源激励了——一个视频、一本书、一次对话，什么都行。

sentences.en: You feel like. This is your moment. So you go all in.
sentences.zh: 你觉得，这就是你的时刻。于是你全力投入。

sentences.en: You start the business. You start working out.
sentences.zh: 你开始创业。你开始健身。

sentences.en: You start learning the skill.
sentences.zh: 你开始学那项技能。

sentences.en: But then, like clockwork, two days a week, two weeks later, you fall off.
sentences.zh: 但然后，像钟表一样准时，两天、一周、两周之后，你就放弃了。

sentences.en: You so easily go back to the life you swore you despised.
sentences.zh: 你如此轻易地回到了那个你发誓自己厌恶的生活。

sentences.en: It's as if you were addicted to it, as if you preferred it over the life you just said you wanted.
sentences.zh: 就好像你对它上瘾了一样，好像比起你刚刚说想要的生活，你更偏爱它。

sentences.en: As if the desire to change your life was just another form of cheap dopamine that you couldn't resist.
sentences.zh: 就好像改变生活的渴望，不过是另一种你无法抗拒的廉价多巴胺。

sentences.en: So life goes on.
sentences.zh: 于是生活继续。

sentences.en: You get another hit of motivation.
sentences.zh: 你又得到一次激励的冲击。

sentences.en: You start again from zero.
sentences.zh: 你再次从零开始。

sentences.en: The cycle repeats.
sentences.zh: 循环往复。

sentences.en: You get frustrated, but not enough to solidify the change.
sentences.zh: 你感到挫败，但还没挫败到足以让改变固化下来。

sentences.en: Then you wake up one, two, ten years later.
sentences.zh: 然后你醒来，一年、两年、十年过去了。

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 到底怎么回事？

sentences.en: Why is this such a common thing?
sentences.zh: 为什么这件事如此普遍？

sentences.en: Why is it so damn hard to change your life?
sentences.zh: 为什么改变生活他妈的就那么难？

sentences.en: And I'll tell you why.
sentences.zh: 我来告诉你为什么。

sentences.en: And it's not anything that you've heard before.
sentences.zh: 而且不是你以前听过的那些东西。

sentences.en: Maybe you've heard of it before, but you haven't really understood it, or else you wouldn't be going through this cycle.
sentences.zh: 也许你以前听过，但你并没有真正理解它，否则你不会还在这个循环里打转。

sentences.en: And another video about productivity, or self-help or motivation or discipline or dopamine isn't even going to solve half the problem.
sentences.zh: 再做一个关于生产力、自我提升、激励、自律或多巴胺的视频，连一半的问题都解决不了。

sentences.en: You've obviously watched enough of those, and nothing's changed.
sentences.zh: 你显然已经看够了那些，什么都没变。

sentences.en: We need to dig much, much deeper into the mind.
sentences.zh: 我们需要往大脑深处挖，挖得深得多。

sentences.en: We need to understand the composition of the mind.
sentences.zh: 我们需要理解大脑的构成。

sentences.en: We're actually going to break that down.
sentences.zh: 我们真的会把它拆解开。

sentences.en: It's like you have how the body is formed, but how is the mind formed?
sentences.zh: 就像你知道身体是怎么构成的，但大脑是怎么构成的？

sentences.en: Do you ever think about that?
sentences.zh: 你有没有想过这个问题？

sentences.en: How is like the intangible parts of your mind, just acting like a puppet master over your actions every single day, to the point where you're not even in control?
sentences.zh: 你大脑里那些无形的东西，怎么就像个提线木偶大师一样，每天操控着你的行为，操控到你甚至无法掌控自己？

sentences.en: Like you can't even change your life.
sentences.zh: 就好像你根本改变不了自己的生活。

sentences.en: So by the end of this video, I hope that you will have what you need to adopt the traits of a highly successful person, specifically a person with this admirable quality.
sentences.zh: 所以到视频结束时，我希望你能掌握成为高成就者所需的特质，尤其是那种令人钦佩的品质。

sentences.en: A person who works with tremendous intensity on things that matter to you, and more importantly, a person who is strangely bothered when those things don't work out.
sentences.zh: 一个以巨大强度投入你在乎之事的人，更重要的是，一个当这些事情不顺利时会感到莫名不安的人。

sentences.en: So if you actually attempt to understand what's in this video, because the first part is dense, you're probably going to fall off within the first part.
sentences.zh: 如果你真的试图理解这个视频的内容，因为第一部分信息密度很高，你很可能在第一部分就掉队。

sentences.en: But if you actually try to understand it, rather than just try to hoard the knowledge like you do every other video, your life will look drastically different in three to 6 to 12 months.
sentences.zh: 但如果你真的试图理解它，而不是像看其他视频那样只是囤积知识，你的生活将在三到六到十二个月内发生巨变。

sentences.en: So the first thing we need to do is we need to understand the composition of the mind, because that's why it's so hard to change.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要做的第一件事，是理解心智的构成，因为这就是改变如此困难的原因。

sentences.en: And your mind is a collection of survival strategies.
sentences.zh: 你的心智是一套生存策略的集合。

sentences.en: This is where it gets dense. This is where it gets complex.
sentences.zh: 这里开始信息密度变高，开始变得复杂。

sentences.en: Don't fall off because understanding this will change just how you view life in general.
sentences.zh: 别掉队，因为理解这一点会彻底改变你看待生活的方式。

sentences.en: Now survival is the mechanical, often unconscious engine behind every thought, emotion and action.
sentences.zh: 生存是机械的、通常无意识的引擎，驱动着每一个想法、情绪和行动。

sentences.en: Everything you think, feel, or do is rooted in survival.
sentences.zh: 你所想、所感、所做的一切，都根植于生存。

sentences.en: I repeat, your entire human experience right now is directed by survival.
sentences.zh: 我重复一遍，你此刻的全部人类体验，都由生存主导。

sentences.en: This is one of the most important topics you can understand to change your life, because it's the root of what's keeping you the same.
sentences.zh: 这是你能理解的最重要的课题之一，足以改变你的人生，因为它是让你停滞不前的根源。

sentences.en: You hear the word survival and you're like, well, I don't live in the past.
sentences.zh: 你听到“生存”这个词，可能会想，我又不是活在过去。

sentences.en: Like I'm not about to be attacked by another tribe.
sentences.zh: 我又不是快要被别的部落攻击了。

sentences.en: What does survival have to do with this? My basic needs are met.
sentences.zh: 生存跟这有什么关系？我的基本需求都满足了。

sentences.en: I'm not talking about that kind of survival.
sentences.zh: 我说的不是那种生存。

sentences.en: And the thing here is that you cannot win this survival game.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，你无法赢得这场生存游戏。

sentences.en: You can only transcend and include it.
sentences.zh: 你只能超越它并包含它。

sentences.en: You can only learn how to play it.
sentences.zh: 你只能学会如何玩这场游戏。

sentences.en: Trying to win this game is the ultimate source of suffering.
sentences.zh: 试图赢得这场游戏，是痛苦的终极来源。

sentences.en: Now, there are two types of survival here that we have to understand it.
sentences.zh: 这里有两种生存类型，我们必须理解。

sentences.en: Most people only understand what the first one is.
sentences.zh: 大多数人只理解第一种。

sentences.en: The first one is physical survival.
sentences.zh: 第一种是肉体生存。

sentences.en: So like animals, we attempt to reproduce the information in our genes.
sentences.zh: 就像动物一样，我们试图复制基因中的信息。

sentences.en: This is largely solved in today's world.
sentences.zh: 这在当今世界基本已解决。

sentences.en: And most reading this aren't worried about getting eaten or dying from starvation.
sentences.zh: 读到这里的多数人，不用担心被吃掉或饿死。

sentences.en: And then there's psychological survival.
sentences.zh: 然后是心理生存。

sentences.en: We also attempt to reproduce the information in our consciousness.
sentences.zh: 我们也试图复制意识中的信息。

sentences.en: We feel the drive to preserve our nonphysical identity the ideas, beliefs, practices, and worldview that shape our mind.
sentences.zh: 我们感受到一种驱动力，去保存我们的非物质身份——那些塑造我们心智的想法、信念、实践和世界观。

sentences.en: So to understand this, we have to understand the gist of what evolution is.
sentences.zh: 要理解这一点，我们必须理解进化的核心要义。

sentences.en: So billions of years ago, some self-replicating molecules existed, and some of them replicated more successfully than others, and the ones that happen to build protective structures around themselves.
sentences.zh: 几十亿年前，存在一些自我复制的分子，其中一些比其他的复制得更成功，而那些恰好能在自身周围构建保护结构的分子。

sentences.en: So cell walls, then cells, then multicellular bodies were better at replicating than others.
sentences.zh: 于是细胞壁、细胞、多细胞生物体，比其他的更擅长复制。

sentences.en: So over billions of iterations or natural selection, we have genes that are very good at building bodies that can survive.
sentences.zh: 经过数十亿次迭代或自然选择，我们拥有了非常擅长构建能生存的身体的基因。

sentences.en: And then human consciousness became a thing.
sentences.zh: 然后人类意识出现了。

sentences.en: I don't know how.
sentences.zh: 我不知道怎么发生的。

sentences.en: Don't ask me how.
sentences.zh: 别问我怎么发生的。

sentences.en: That's not what we're here to talk about.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们今天要聊的。

sentences.en: But the same process continued.
sentences.zh: 但同样的过程在继续。

sentences.en: So we have genes which selected and self-replicating, and then we have memes.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有基因，它们被筛选、自我复制，然后我们有了模因。

sentences.en: And this is the difficult part, because when you think of memes today, you think of memes on your phone like your friend sends you a meme.
sentences.zh: 这是最难理解的部分，因为今天你想到模因，想到的是手机上的梗图，朋友发给你的那种。

sentences.en: But what a meme really is, is a unit of culture that is spread from mind to mind.
sentences.zh: 但模因真正的含义，是文化的基本单位，从一个头脑传播到另一个头脑。

sentences.en: So think words or language or concepts, or the beliefs that your parents pass down to you that you didn't even have the time to question because like, you didn't know any better as a kid or when you went to school and you were you were rewarded for getting good grades and punished for getting bad grades.
sentences.zh: 比如词语、语言、概念，或者你父母传给你的信念，你甚至没时间去质疑，因为你小时候什么都不懂，或者上学时你考高分被奖励、考低分被惩罚。

sentences.en: Or if throughout your entire childhood you were told to go to school, get a job, retire at 65.
sentences.zh: 或者你的整个童年，都有人告诉你：上学、找工作、65岁退休。

sentences.en: And in today's world, with AI and things accelerated so quickly, that's not beneficial for your future.
sentences.zh: 而在今天这个世界，AI 和一切加速得这么快，那对你的未来没有好处。

sentences.en: But so many people are stuck in that paradigm.
sentences.zh: 但太多人被那个范式困住了。

sentences.en: The memes that compose their mind and dictate their actions are not aligned with what's going to lead to success in today's world.
sentences.zh: 构成他们头脑、支配他们行动的模因，跟今天这个世界能带来成功的东西不匹配。

sentences.en: But the thing about these memes is that one they compose your mind.
sentences.zh: 但这些模因的关键在于，第一，它们构成了你的头脑。

sentences.en: If your genes kind of compose your body or dictate how like what your body can do, then memes do the same thing for your mind.
sentences.zh: 如果说基因构成了你的身体，或者说决定了你身体能做什么，那模因对你的头脑做的是一样的事。

sentences.en: So ideas, beliefs, habits, practices, traditions, other things of that nature.
sentences.zh: 所以是想法、信念、习惯、做法、传统，诸如此类的东西。

sentences.en: And the thing with memes, if I haven't already said this, is that they're just like genes, like they have naturally selected over time and culture through creation and destruction, to the point where the memes inside of our head, their sole goal is to persist.
sentences.zh: 而模因的特点，如果我还没说过的话，就是它们跟基因一样，在时间和文化中通过创造与毁灭自然选择，到了今天这个地步，我们头脑里的模因，它们唯一的目标就是存续。

sentences.en: Their sole goal is to go on, to survive, to self-replicating.
sentences.zh: 它们唯一的目标就是继续下去、活下去、自我复制。

sentences.en: That's why the memes that compose who you are right now.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么构成你现在是谁的那些模因。

sentences.en: Don't want you to change.
sentences.zh: 不想让你改变。

sentences.en: And they're going to try to avoid changing by all means possible.
sentences.zh: 它们会不惜一切代价避免改变。

sentences.en: We'll learn more about that soon.
sentences.zh: 我们很快会了解更多。

sentences.en: Now, one important survival mechanism of memes are institutions and ideologies.
sentences.zh: 现在，模因的一个重要生存机制是机构和意识形态。

sentences.en: We create larger structures like religions or nations, or political parties and corporations that have the goal of protecting, perpetuating, and replicating the beliefs and values they were founded on.
sentences.zh: 我们创造出更大的结构，比如宗教、国家、政党、公司，它们的目标是保护、延续和复制它们建立时所基于的信念和价值观。

sentences.en: Religions want more members, nations want more control, and corporations want more customers.
sentences.zh: 宗教想要更多成员，国家想要更多控制，公司想要更多顾客。

sentences.en: So religion that tells its adherence to have children and convert other people to the religion is obviously going to spread and replicate faster than a religion who just tells people to not have kids and stay quiet, obviously.
sentences.zh: 所以一个告诉信徒多生孩子、转化他人的宗教，显然会比一个告诉人们别生孩子、保持沉默的宗教传播和复制得更快，这很明显。

sentences.en: And I promise we're getting to a point here, because what I'm saying is that the memes in your head, who you are, how you act, are shaped by those memes or the information or the language or the words or the identifications or the concepts or all of these things that compose your mind.
sentences.zh: 我保证我们快说到重点了，因为我在说的是，你头脑里的模因，你是谁、你怎么行动，是被那些模因塑造的，或者说被那些信息、语言、词语、身份认同、概念，所有这些构成你头脑的东西塑造的。

sentences.en: It's really hard to put together.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难拼凑起来。

sentences.en: These things are fighting for survival because they're like genes.
sentences.zh: 这些东西在为生存而战，因为它们就像基因。

sentences.en: They naturally self replicated into what they are today.
sentences.zh: 它们自然自我复制成了今天的样子。

sentences.en: So just like the example I just gave with the religion that tells people to have more kids and to convert other members applies to other things as well.
sentences.zh: 所以就像我刚举的那个宗教的例子，告诉人们多生孩子、转化其他成员，这同样适用于其他东西。

sentences.en: It applies to political ideologies.
sentences.zh: 适用于政治意识形态。

sentences.en: It applies to brands, conspiracy theories, jokes, fashion, the clothes that you wear, video games, which video games you play, which video games you identify with, the culture within that coffee, alcohol.
sentences.zh: 适用于品牌、阴谋论、笑话、时尚、你穿的衣服、电子游戏、你玩哪个游戏、你认同哪个游戏、那个游戏里的文化，咖啡、酒精。

sentences.en: Whether you're Team Apple or Team Android or Team Claude, or Team ChatGPT or Team Anti AI, or Team Keto, or Team Carnivore or Team Vegan, and really anything else.
sentences.zh: 你是 Team Apple 还是 Team Android，是 Team Claude 还是 Team ChatGPT，是 Team 反 AI，还是 Team 生酮、Team 肉食、Team 纯素，以及任何其他东西。

sentences.en: And now these are things that are outside of you, right?
sentences.zh: 而这些，都是你之外的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: The point that I'm trying to get at here and why I talked about the complicated things such as memes, you don't really need to understand that.
sentences.zh: 我想说的重点是，也是为什么我要讲模因这些复杂的东西，你其实不需要完全搞懂它。

sentences.en: What you need to understand is that everything is a religion.
sentences.zh: 你需要搞懂的是：一切都是宗教。

sentences.en: Your morning routine is a religion.
sentences.zh: 你的晨间流程是一种宗教。

sentences.en: Your political opinions are a religion.
sentences.zh: 你的政治观点是一种宗教。

sentences.en: Your identity as a gamer, a lifter, a minimalist, a stoic, a craft beer enthusiast.
sentences.zh: 你作为游戏玩家、健身狂、极简主义者、斯多葛主义者、精酿啤酒爱好者的身份。

sentences.en: They're all religions, and with social media and global access to information, were experiencing the religion of everything.
sentences.zh: 它们全都是宗教，而有了社交媒体和全球信息接入，我们正在经历“万物皆宗教”的时代。

sentences.en: Very few people actually do things because they want to anymore.
sentences.zh: 现在已经很少有人是真的因为想做一件事才去做。

sentences.en: Almost everyone's life is built around actions that allows them to fit in to the digital tribe or the digital culture.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有人的生活，都建立在那些能让自己融入数字部落或数字文化的行为之上。

sentences.en: So our bodies are built by genes to replicate genes.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们的身体由基因构建，目的是复制基因。

sentences.en: Our identities are built by memes, to replicate memes.
sentences.zh: 我们的身份由模因构建，目的是复制模因。

sentences.en: And again, a meme is a unit of culture that spreads from mind to mind and its only goal or observed goal.
sentences.zh: 再说一遍，模因是文化的基本单位，从一个头脑传播到另一个头脑，它唯一的目标，或者说我们观察到的目标。

sentences.en: When you look at what a meme does is it tries to persist, it tries to survive.
sentences.zh: 当你审视模因在做什么，你会发现它试图存续，它试图生存。

sentences.en: So I think you get it right.
sentences.zh: 我想你应该明白了。

sentences.en: I think you understand that your mind is trying to survive.
sentences.zh: 我想你理解了，你的头脑也在试图生存。

sentences.en: So how does this actually relate to getting stuck in this vicious cycle of trying to achieve a goal that you say you want to achieve, but then just falling off and kind of getting stuck in, getting motivated, falling off, getting motivated, falling off, what does it have to do with that?
sentences.zh: 那这到底跟你陷入那个恶性循环有什么关系？你说你想达成一个目标，但总是半途而废，陷入“打鸡血—放弃—打鸡血—放弃”的循环，这跟它有什么关系？

sentences.en: It has to do with the fact that your mind is a self-deception machine.
sentences.zh: 关系就在于：你的头脑是一台自我欺骗机器。

sentences.en: When you try to pursue a goal that would fundamentally change who you are.
sentences.zh: 当你试图追求一个会从根本上改变你自身的那个目标。

sentences.en: So your self-image, your identity, it's hard to conceptualize that there is a mental body, that there is a you because you think your body is you and that you're just you.
sentences.zh: 也就是改变你的自我形象、你的身份。很难想象存在一个“心理身体”，存在一个“你”，因为你以为你的身体就是你，你就是你。

sentences.en: But it's a composition of these ideas, beliefs, worldviews, etc. that were conditioned into your head by your parents, teachers and peers and that you never really had the chance to question because you didn't know any better.
sentences.zh: 但它其实是由各种观念、信念、世界观等组成的，这些东西是你的父母、老师、同伴灌输进你脑子里的，而你从来没有真正有机会去质疑，因为你那时候不懂。

sentences.en: As a kid, you haven't observed and examined what is this like web of ideas that actually composes who I am.
sentences.zh: 小时候，你没有观察和审视过：到底是一张什么样的观念之网，构成了“我是谁”。

sentences.en: And so when you try to change who you are.
sentences.zh: 所以当你试图改变“你是谁”的时候。

sentences.en: It's very difficult to notice because your mind doesn't want you to notice.
sentences.zh: 这很难察觉，因为你的头脑不想让你察觉。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: The memes in your head are trying to survive and replicate, so your ego starts throwing out defensive reactions left and right.
sentences.zh: 你脑子里的模因在试图生存和复制，所以你的自我开始左右开弓地抛出防御反应。

sentences.en: Your mind starts to flood with anxiety, fear of failure, irrational thinking, and the closest distraction that will give you a quick hit of comfort.
sentences.zh: 你的头脑开始被焦虑、对失败的恐惧、非理性思考淹没，还有那个离你最近的、能给你快速舒适感的分心事物。

sentences.en: It's like an addict going through withdrawals and those things.
sentences.zh: 就像一个成瘾者在经历戒断反应一样。

sentences.en: That anxiety, the fear of failure.
sentences.zh: 那种焦虑，那种对失败的恐惧。

sentences.en: Really, your old identity trying to claw its way back is kind of synonymous with, like in the past, if you were attacked, or even now if you're held at gunpoint or you're about to die, your body goes into fight or flight.
sentences.zh: 真的，你的旧身份试图爬回来，这跟过去你被攻击时，或者现在被人用枪指着、快要死的时候，身体进入“战斗或逃跑”模式，几乎是同义词。

sentences.en: The same thing happens to your mind because your identity or your psychological body is trying not to die.
sentences.zh: 同样的事情发生在你的头脑里，因为你的身份，或者说你的心理身体，正在试图不死。

sentences.en: Now, the thing here is that this is just a natural thing.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，这只是一个自然现象。

sentences.en: This is how we've evolved to be.
sentences.zh: 我们就是这样进化过来的。

sentences.en: So the cool thing about being human is that you can zoom out in, detach from this stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以作为人类最酷的一点是，你可以抽离出来，从这些东西中跳脱。

sentences.en: So how do you actually zoom out, see the composition of your mind, and then make tweaks?
sentences.zh: 那么，你到底要怎么抽离出来，看清你头脑的构成，然后做出调整？

sentences.en: How do you reprogram it so that the opposite happens?
sentences.zh: 你怎么重新编程它，让相反的事情发生？

sentences.en: And this is the key point.
sentences.zh: 这就是关键所在。

sentences.en: This is the mind blowing part if you get it.
sentences.zh: 如果你能理解，这才是真正让你脑洞大开的部分。

sentences.en: What if you felt threatened when you stopped pursuing a meaningful goal?
sentences.zh: 如果你停止追求有意义的目标，反而会感到威胁——会怎样？

sentences.en: So much so that achieving the meaningful goal didn't require much discipline because it's just a part of who you are.
sentences.zh: 以至于实现那个有意义的目标根本不需要太多自律，因为它已经是你身份的一部分。

sentences.en: It's what your mind wants to survive.
sentences.zh: 它是你的心智想要赖以生存的东西。

sentences.en: It's what your mind wants to do.
sentences.zh: 它是你的心智想要去做的事。

sentences.en: So with that complex section out of the way, we need to actually get into the meat of what's going on here.
sentences.zh: 好了，复杂的那部分讲完了，我们得真正进入核心内容了。

sentences.en: We have to understand this survival game, and we need to understand how to leverage it in our favor.
sentences.zh: 我们必须理解这场生存游戏，也必须理解如何让它为我们所用。

sentences.en: And if it helps, just think of this as the mind game, right?
sentences.zh: 如果有帮助的话，直接把这当成一场心智游戏，对吧？

sentences.en: This is the mind game of life.
sentences.zh: 这就是人生的心智游戏。

sentences.en: And most people don't play it because they are a slave to their mind.
sentences.zh: 而大多数人根本不玩这场游戏，因为他们是自己心智的奴隶。

sentences.en: And the characteristic of being a slave to your mind is that you don't even know it.
sentences.zh: 做心智奴隶的特征就是，你甚至不知道自己是个奴隶。

sentences.en: You don't know you're a slave, so you need to become the master, so to say, instead.
sentences.zh: 你不知道自己是奴隶，所以你得反过来成为主人，可以这么说。

sentences.en: So we'll start with this.
sentences.zh: 那我们从这里开始。

sentences.en: Effortless self-discipline happens when the desire to become the highest version of yourself outweighs the desires of the lowest version of yourself.
sentences.zh: 毫不费力的自律，发生在成为最高版本自己的渴望，压倒了最低版本自己的欲望之时。

sentences.en: Now, the key point that I want you to understand here is that the core difference between winners and losers is that losers are afraid of success, while winners are afraid of mediocrity.
sentences.zh: 现在，我想让你理解的关键点是：赢家和输家的核心区别在于，输家害怕成功，而赢家害怕平庸。

sentences.en: As an example, the person who does not identify as a fit person will feel threatened when they make the commitment to be healthy.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，一个不认同自己是健康型的人，当他下定决心要变得健康时，会感到威胁。

sentences.en: You may not consciously identify as an unfit or unhealthy person, but you identify with the preferences, habits, and abilities or the properties of the self of your mind that an unfit person would have.
sentences.zh: 你可能并没有有意识地认同自己是个不健康的人，但你认同了那些不健康的人才会有的偏好、习惯、能力，或者说心智自我的属性。

sentences.en: So when you try to change and become a healthy person, your mind starts sending warning signals because it's threatened.
sentences.zh: 所以当你试图改变、成为一个健康的人时，你的心智就开始发出警告信号，因为它感受到了威胁。

sentences.en: It starts asking questions like what happens to going out and partying with my friends?
sentences.zh: 它开始问这样的问题：那出去跟朋友聚会喝酒怎么办？

sentences.en: What happens to the late night snacks while watching Netflix?
sentences.zh: 那看 Netflix 时的深夜零食怎么办？

sentences.en: What happens to relaxing on the couch instead of going on a walk?
sentences.zh: 那躺在沙发上休息、不去散步怎么办？

sentences.en: All of the little things start to surface, even if you're not consciously aware of them.
sentences.zh: 所有这些小事都会浮现出来，即使你并没有有意识地察觉到它们。

sentences.en: Like, oh, what happens if I have to eat this bland food?
sentences.zh: 比如，哦，那我要是得吃这种寡淡无味的食物怎么办？

sentences.en: You're telling me I can't add an entire stick of butter to this thing because it tastes better?
sentences.zh: 你是说我不能往这里面加一整块黄油，就因为加了更好吃？

sentences.en: What if you never had a slab of butter in your food before in your entire life?
sentences.zh: 如果你这辈子从来没在食物里放过一块黄油呢？

sentences.en: What if you didn't even know that thing existed?
sentences.zh: 如果你甚至都不知道有这种东西存在呢？

sentences.en: Would you resist that change?
sentences.zh: 你还会抗拒那个改变吗？

sentences.en: Or would you eat the bland food?
sentences.zh: 还是会吃下那些寡淡的食物？

sentences.en: Or would the bland food be good to you? Because that's all you know.
sentences.zh: 或者那些寡淡的食物对你来说会不会其实是好吃的？因为那是你所知道的全部。

sentences.en: And so if you're trying to be healthy when the opportunity comes to go out or relax on the couch or add the slab of butter to your meal, are you actually going to be able to break that deeply ingrained pattern?
sentences.zh: 所以，当你想变得健康，而出去聚会、躺在沙发上、或者往饭里加一块黄油的机会出现时，你真的能打破那个根深蒂固的模式吗？

sentences.en: The thing here is that the fit person would be threatened by the opposite.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，那个健康型的人会被相反的东西威胁。

sentences.en: This is the key to changing your life in general, and this would baffle the unfit person because they don't understand it, they can't understand it.
sentences.zh: 这是从根本上改变你人生的关键，而这会让那个不健康的人感到困惑，因为他们不理解，他们无法理解。

sentences.en: So if a fit person travels to a place where they're not in their normal routine, or they don't have access to the same healthy food that they would eat, or their meal plan or their diet plan, and let's say the only place they can eat is McDonald's.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果一个健康型的人去了一个地方，不在他日常的节奏里，或者吃不到他平时吃的那些健康食物，没有他的饮食计划，假设唯一能吃饭的地方是 McDonald's。

sentences.en: If that was their limitation, then they almost like, spontaneously combust.
sentences.zh: 如果这就是他们的限制条件，他们几乎会当场自爆。

sentences.en: They think they're going to lose all their gains in an instant.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得自己一瞬间就会前功尽弃。

sentences.en: Every single negative thought starts to flood their mind of like, I've worked so hard for this, this is who I am.
sentences.zh: 每一个负面念头开始涌入大脑：我为此付出了那么多努力，这就是我。

sentences.en: I'm a fit person.
sentences.zh: 我是一个健康的人。

sentences.en: If I touch this one single seed oil, then I die.
sentences.zh: 只要碰一滴种子油，我就会死。

sentences.en: Because I've studied all of the people on Twitter and Instagram talking about how seed oil is are bad, and I've adopted that as a part of my identity.
sentences.zh: 因为我研究了 Twitter 和 Instagram 上所有说种子油有害的人，然后把这当成了我身份的一部分。

sentences.en: It's a meme that's trying to replicate and survive, and I've joined this tribe, and I want to feel as if I fit into that tribe.
sentences.zh: 这是一个试图复制和存活的模因，我加入了这个部落，我想感觉自己属于这个部落。

sentences.en: So if I even one seed oil, I'm cast out from the tribe and my mind is wired like my ancestors was me personally, I can't distinguish then from now.
sentences.zh: 所以只要碰一滴种子油，我就被部落驱逐了，而我的大脑连接方式和我祖先一样——我个人无法区分过去和现在。

sentences.en: So I feel like I'm at threat.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉自己受到了威胁。

sentences.en: I feel like I'm going to die, even though I don't specifically say that that's what my body and mind feels.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己要死了，虽然我不会明确这么说，但我的身体和大脑就是这么感觉的。

sentences.en: And because my body and mind have evolved to this point, it's going to fight tooth and nail to keep me the same, keep me the fit and healthy person that I identify as.
sentences.zh: 而因为我的身体和大脑已经进化到了这个地步，它会拼命抵抗，让我保持不变，让我继续做我认同的那个健康的人。

sentences.en: Now, if you don't care about being healthy or unhealthy or whatever it is, almost everyone wants to make money.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你不在乎健康或不健康之类的事，但几乎每个人都想赚钱。

sentences.en: The same thing applies to every single domain of life.
sentences.zh: 同样的事情适用于生活的每一个领域。

sentences.en: This is life.
sentences.zh: 这就是人生。

sentences.en: So the businessman or someone who starts a business and is actually good at it and it has become a part of their identity, they would feel like a failure if their revenue started to go down, so much so that they would do anything to get it back up.
sentences.zh: 所以一个商人，或者一个创业并且确实做得不错、这已经成为他身份一部分的人，如果收入开始下滑，他会觉得自己是个失败者，以至于他会不惜一切代价把收入拉回来。

sentences.en: They're going to study, they're going to learn, they're going to talk to people.
sentences.zh: 他会去研究，去学习，去跟人聊。

sentences.en: They're going to try to identify the bottleneck in their business.
sentences.zh: 他会试图找出业务中的瓶颈。

sentences.en: They're going to implement new things. They're going to fire people.
sentences.zh: 他会实施新方案，他会开掉人。

sentences.en: They're going to do whatever they can to get the revenue going back up.
sentences.zh: 他会做任何能做的事，让收入重新涨起来。

sentences.en: They're going to compete with other people, they're going to copy other people's features, so on and so forth.
sentences.zh: 他会跟别人竞争，他会抄袭别人的功能，等等等等。

sentences.en: They wouldn't be able to sleep at night until that problem is resolved.
sentences.zh: 在那个问题解决之前，他晚上根本睡不着觉。

sentences.en: And now some of this I'm being hyperbolic.
sentences.zh: 当然，我有些地方是在夸张。

sentences.en: This is the really extreme cases.
sentences.zh: 这些是极端案例。

sentences.en: But even in the subtle cases, it's enough to influence your behavior to the point of staying the same, which is the problem that we're trying to solve here.
sentences.zh: 但即便是那些不那么极端的情况，也足以影响你的行为，让你保持原样，而这正是我们想要解决的问题。

sentences.en: So how did you actually get to this point in your life right now, to the point where you can't change?
sentences.zh: 那么，你到底是怎么走到今天这一步的，走到这个你无法改变的地步？

sentences.en: It's so hard to change. You keep locking in and falling off.
sentences.zh: 改变太难了。你不断坚持，又不断崩掉。

sentences.en: Well, when you were young, people expected you to act, think and behave a certain way.
sentences.zh: 是这样的，你小时候，人们期望你以某种方式行动、思考和表现。

sentences.en: Your parents were influenced by their parents and culture.
sentences.zh: 你的父母受到他们父母和文化的影响。

sentences.en: Your parents worldview was passed on to you as a child.
sentences.zh: 你父母的世界观在你小时候传给了你。

sentences.en: You started growing up.
sentences.zh: 你开始长大。

sentences.en: Maybe you rebelled a bit, but you couldn't escape the subtle programing from your teachers, peers, and even worse, in today's world social media, you could effectively search up any information on the internet and program yourself into being a part of a tribe whose general actions aren't beneficial to a meaningful future.
sentences.zh: 也许你叛逆过一阵，但你逃不掉来自老师、同龄人的潜移默化，更糟的是，在今天这个世界，还有社交媒体，你可以有效地在互联网上搜索任何信息，然后把自己编程成一个部落的一员，而这个部落的普遍行为并不导向一个有意义的未来。

sentences.en: Literally, the places that you hang out on the internet could dictate the entire outcome of your life, and you don't pay any attention to it.
sentences.zh: 毫不夸张地说，你在互联网上混迹的地方，可以决定你人生的整个走向，而你对此毫无察觉。

sentences.en: You just let all of these things unguarded go into your mind.
sentences.zh: 你只是让这些东西毫无防备地进入你的大脑。

sentences.en: And I mean, think about how just insane that is, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，想想这有多疯狂，对吧？

sentences.en: You have this house that you live in.
sentences.zh: 你住在一栋房子里。

sentences.en: Are you just going to leave the door unlocked?
sentences.zh: 你会就这么把门敞着不锁吗？

sentences.en: And then are you going to, like, I don't know, let everyone come in and party and just ruin your house and then leave or even just stay?
sentences.zh: 然后你会不会，怎么说呢，让所有人都进来开派对，把你的房子搞得一团糟然后走人，甚至干脆住下？

sentences.en: Are you going to let people live in your house?
sentences.zh: 你会让别人住在你家里吗？

sentences.en: Are you going to let 100 people live in your small apartment with you on your bed?
sentences.zh: 你会让100个人挤在你那间小公寓里，跟你一起躺在一张床上吗？

sentences.en: Like, it just doesn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 这根本说不通。

sentences.en: They're going to eat all your food they're going to do.
sentences.zh: 他们会吃光你所有的食物，他们会干各种事。

sentences.en: That's what's happening in your mind.
sentences.zh: 这就是你脑子里正在发生的事。

sentences.en: But the good thing is, is that you can flip the script here.
sentences.zh: 但好消息是，你可以把剧本翻过来。

sentences.en: You can just turn it around, not easily, but you can turn it around.
sentences.zh: 你可以直接扭转局面，不容易，但你可以扭转。

sentences.en: You can change from a person who is threatened by success to a person who is threatened by failure.
sentences.zh: 你可以从一个被成功威胁的人，变成一个被失败威胁的人。

sentences.en: So the thing here is, I want to teach you how to weaponize your survival mechanism in your head, and you'll get results from that.
sentences.zh: 所以关键在于，我想教你如何把你脑子里的生存机制变成武器，你会从中拿到结果。

sentences.en: But you have to understand that you will still suffer until you transcend the game.
sentences.zh: 但你必须明白，在你超越这场游戏之前，你依然会受苦。

sentences.en: And that's what we're going to talk about in the last section of this video.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在这支视频最后一部分要聊的。

sentences.en: Now, with that said, this isn't going to happen overnight.
sentences.zh: 好了，话说到这，这件事不会一夜之间发生。

sentences.en: You're going to go through withdrawals, you will have relapses.
sentences.zh: 你会经历戒断反应，你会复发。

sentences.en: But these things are what I found to be the most potent for recreating yourself.
sentences.zh: 但这些东西是我发现对重塑自己最有效的东西。

sentences.en: These aren't exhaustive.
sentences.zh: 这些不是全部。

sentences.en: These aren't all of them.
sentences.zh: 不是所有方法。

sentences.en: These might not even help you specifically, but these are what helped me.
sentences.zh: 这些甚至不一定专门对你有用，但这些是帮到我的东西。

sentences.en: Now, all of these four things overlap and synergize with each other.
sentences.zh: 这四件事是相互重叠、相互协同的。

sentences.en: So one leads to another and they stack.
sentences.zh: 所以一件事会导向另一件，它们会叠加。

sentences.en: So the first thing is that you need a reason with extremely high gravitational pull.
sentences.zh: 第一件事是，你需要一个具有极强引力牵引力的理由。

sentences.en: And when that fades you must find another.
sentences.zh: 当这个理由消退时，你必须找到下一个。

sentences.en: Because the most intense periods of my life came after I stumbled across a very intense reason to change.
sentences.zh: 因为我人生中最密集的阶段，都是在我偶然撞见一个极其强烈的改变理由之后出现的。

sentences.en: It was a reason with such an intense pull that I couldn't focus on anything else but actualizing the positive trajectory of my life.
sentences.zh: 那个理由的牵引力如此之强，以至于我除了去实现人生的正向轨迹之外，什么都无法专注。

sentences.en: And the thing is, this reason doesn't last forever.
sentences.zh: 问题是，这个理由不会永远持续。

sentences.en: You can quickly find yourself back in a rut months later because you let autopilot take over, and it's difficult.
sentences.zh: 几个月后你可能会很快发现自己又回到了泥潭里，因为你让自动驾驶接管了，这很难。

sentences.en: It's very difficult to force this reason.
sentences.zh: 强行制造这个理由非常困难。

sentences.en: I've talked about related topics on my YouTube channel a few times, and whenever I put out a video, I can't help but think like, this just isn't going to hit for some people.
sentences.zh: 我在我的YouTube频道上聊过几次相关话题，每次我发视频的时候，我都忍不住想，这对一些人来说就是打不中。

sentences.en: This isn't going to hit for the majority of the people that watch this, because they're not at the rate, they're not at the right phase in life in which this information will cause that spark to change.
sentences.zh: 这对看这支视频的大多数人都打不中，因为他们不在那个阶段，他们不在人生的正确阶段，在这个阶段这些信息才会引发改变的火花。

sentences.en: People try to do that all the time.
sentences.zh: 人们一直在试图这么做。

sentences.en: They try to just force themselves into action or force themselves to think through everything, and they still can't change.
sentences.zh: 他们试图强行让自己行动，或者强行让自己想通一切，但他们依然无法改变。

sentences.en: So what has to happen here?
sentences.zh: 所以这里必须发生什么？

sentences.en: You have to find the reason in a book, a conversation or experience that happens at such a perfect moment that everything clicks for you.
sentences.zh: 你必须在一本书、一次对话或一段经历中，在某个完美时刻找到那个理由，让一切豁然开朗。

sentences.en: You have to discover it by breaking out of the familiar past and predictable future.
sentences.zh: 你必须通过打破熟悉的过去和可预测的未来，去发现它。

sentences.en: Because for most people, right when they wake up, they are met with a thought that triggers a behavior, and instantly they are now operating as the past version of themselves.
sentences.zh: 因为对大多数人来说，一醒来就会被一个念头击中，触发一种行为，瞬间他们就开始以过去的那个自己运转。

sentences.en: You think about the commute to work, which was stressful for you in the past, so you bring that feeling into the present and now you're stressed and narrow minded.
sentences.zh: 你想到通勤上班，过去这件事让你压力很大，于是你把那种感觉带到了当下，现在你压力大、思维狭隘。

sentences.en: Then the cascade continues.
sentences.zh: 然后连锁反应继续。

sentences.en: You experience the feelings and behaviors of your past, which create a predictable future that you don't want.
sentences.zh: 你体验着过去的感受和行为，它们创造出一个你不想要的、可预测的未来。

sentences.en: You get stuck in this loop of living yesterday.
sentences.zh: 你被困在这个重复昨天的循环里。

sentences.en: Today you don't do anything new.
sentences.zh: 今天你不做任何新事。

sentences.en: You don't break the pattern.
sentences.zh: 你不打破模式。

sentences.en: And so only in the unknown, only in the things that you haven't experienced so far, or at least internalized or made repetitive, is where you will find the novel insight that will launch you into the next phase of life.
sentences.zh: 所以只有在未知里，只有在你尚未经历过、或者至少尚未内化或重复的事情里，你才能找到那个全新的洞见，把你推向人生的下一个阶段。

sentences.en: So how do you start to live in the unknown?
sentences.zh: 那么，你如何开始活在未知里？

sentences.en: That leads to point two, which is that you need to become brutally aware of who you don't want to become.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了第二点：你需要对自己不想成为谁，变得极其清醒。

sentences.en: Now, in my opinion, the most powerful visualization exercise you can do is this for the next day, look at all of your current actions.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，你能做的最有力的可视化练习就是这个：接下来的一天，审视你当前的所有行为。

sentences.en: Look at them all.
sentences.zh: 审视它们全部。

sentences.en: What you do when you wake up, what you do throughout the day, what you do at night.
sentences.zh: 你醒来时做什么，一天中做什么，晚上做什么。

sentences.en: Now sit with a pen and paper and write down exactly where your life is going to end up.
sentences.zh: 然后坐下来，拿出纸笔，写下如果你继续做同样的事，你的人生最终会走向哪里。

sentences.en: If you keep doing the same thing.
sentences.zh: 如果你继续做同样的事。

sentences.en: And if you're honest with yourself here, the answer preferably would discussed you.
sentences.zh: 如果你在这里对自己诚实，答案最好是让你厌恶的。

sentences.en: And that discussed can be used as this ultra potent fuel to slingshot you in a positive direction for quite a long time until you need a new reason.
sentences.zh: 那种厌恶可以作为一种超强燃料，把你弹射到一个积极的方向上，持续相当长的时间，直到你需要一个新的理由。

sentences.en: So none of this is permanent.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都不是永久的。

sentences.en: You aren't going to find your quick little fix.
sentences.zh: 你不会找到什么快速小妙招。

sentences.en: That's just going to solve everything for the rest of your life.
sentences.zh: 能一劳永逸地解决所有问题。

sentences.en: That's not how life works. Nothing is permanent.
sentences.zh: 人生不是这样运作的。没有什么是永久的。

sentences.en: Now, the problem here that I've seen and experienced is that most people are just dishonest.
sentences.zh: 我见过也经历过的问题在于，大多数人就是不诚实。

sentences.en: This visualization of where they're going to end up in life doesn't really hit them.
sentences.zh: 这种对自己人生终局的想象，并没有真正击中他们。

sentences.en: So why doesn't it hit them?
sentences.zh: 那为什么没有击中他们？

sentences.en: It's because the self doing the exercise is the self being evaluated.
sentences.zh: 因为做这个练习的自我，正是被评估的那个自我。

sentences.en: You are asking the current identity to honestly assess where the current identity is heading, but the current identity has a survival interest in not seeing this clearly, because seeing it clearly would mean death.
sentences.zh: 你在要求当前的身份，诚实地评估当前身份正走向何方，但当前身份有一个生存利益，就是看不清这一点，因为看清了就意味着死亡。

sentences.en: So you soften the blow, you rationalize it.
sentences.zh: 所以你减轻冲击，把它合理化。

sentences.en: You imagine future variables that may rescue you.
sentences.zh: 你想象未来可能有变量来拯救你。

sentences.en: So changing right now doesn't really matter.
sentences.zh: 所以现在改变并不真的重要。

sentences.en: So for this exercise to work, you have to be able to receive the honest answer.
sentences.zh: 因此，要让这个练习奏效，你必须能够接收那个诚实的答案。

sentences.en: And what helps is just grounding this in reality.
sentences.zh: 有帮助的做法是，把它扎根在现实里。

sentences.en: So you have to observe society.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须观察社会。

sentences.en: You have to observe the people around you.
sentences.zh: 你必须观察你身边的人。

sentences.en: That's very potent.
sentences.zh: 这招非常有力。

sentences.en: You have to find an anchor for where your life is going to end up.
sentences.zh: 你必须为你的人生终点找到一个锚点。

sentences.en: That could be in your parents, that could be in a random person at the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 这个锚点可能是你的父母，可能是杂货店里一个随机的人。

sentences.en: There could be a person at the gym.
sentences.zh: 可能是健身房里的某个人。

sentences.en: If you live in a city, just go walk out in the city and look at how lifeless people look.
sentences.zh: 如果你住在城市里，就走到街上去，看看人们脸上那种毫无生气的样子。

sentences.en: And another thing that is the real requirement here, which again, is hard to fake, is that you need something that has already created a crack.
sentences.zh: 还有一件事是真正的必要条件，同样很难伪装，那就是你需要一个已经制造出裂缝的东西。

sentences.en: So when you actually do that exercise of visualization, it just splits you open.
sentences.zh: 这样当你真正去做那个视觉化的练习时，它会直接把你撕开。

sentences.en: So what creates the crack?
sentences.zh: 那么，什么能制造裂缝？

sentences.en: For most people, something catastrophic has to happen before they actually make the real decision to change.
sentences.zh: 对大多数人来说，必须有某种灾难性的事情发生，他们才会真正做出改变的决定。

sentences.en: So their car has to break down before they realize how broke they are and that they're not able to afford it.
sentences.zh: 比如他们的车必须坏掉，他们才会意识到自己有多穷，根本修不起。

sentences.en: And so they have to actually do something to make more money to be able to fix it, or for that not to happen again because they hated the experience so much.
sentences.zh: 于是他们必须真的去做点什么来赚更多钱，才能把车修好，或者因为太痛恨那种体验，所以绝不让它再次发生。

sentences.en: Or you have to have something like a health scare, like maybe you need to have a heart attack.
sentences.zh: 或者你必须经历一次健康危机，比如也许你需要犯一次心脏病。

sentences.en: I'm not saying go and do that, but a lot of people, they have that and they're like, oh shit, I need to be healthy or something else happens, like a parent or a loved one dies and it just hits you really hard.
sentences.zh: 我不是说让你去干这个，但很多人经历了这种事，然后就想，妈的，我必须健康起来。或者是别的事，比如父母或挚爱去世，那种打击非常沉重。

sentences.en: Or a very common example when you're a kid and you go through a breakup and you're just like in emotional turmoil.
sentences.zh: 或者一个很常见的例子，你年轻时经历一次分手，整个人陷入情绪漩涡。

sentences.en: And so you decide, I'm going to go to the gym, I'm going to get jacked, and so on and so forth.
sentences.zh: 于是你下定决心，我要去健身房，我要练壮，等等等等。

sentences.en: I'm going to make sure this never happens again.
sentences.zh: 我要确保这种事永远不会再发生。

sentences.en: And obviously that doesn't solve the problem, but you get the point that someone's behavior and habits can change very fast once they go through a catastrophic event.
sentences.zh: 显然这解决不了根本问题，但你应该明白这个道理：一个人一旦经历了灾难性事件，行为和习惯可以改变得非常快。

sentences.en: Now, point number three is that you need to change your environment faster than the identity can recalibrate because your old self is partly stored in your surroundings.
sentences.zh: 好，第三点是，你需要以比身份认同重新校准更快的速度改变你的环境，因为你的旧自我有一部分储存在你的周遭环境里。

sentences.en: The people you follow online, your bed, your routine, the people you hang out with.
sentences.zh: 你在网上关注的人、你的床、你的日常惯例、你一起混的人。

sentences.en: That's a big one and points to why so many people aren't where they want to be in life.
sentences.zh: 这一点非常重要，也解释了为什么那么多人没有活成自己想要的样子。

sentences.en: Your identity is often programed socially.
sentences.zh: 你的身份认同往往是社会性编程的结果。

sentences.en: The same person in two different friend groups will behave like two different people, more so when you log on to social media, you also become a different person.
sentences.zh: 同一个人在两个不同的朋友圈子里，会表现得像两个完全不同的人。更不用说当你登录社交媒体时，你也会变成另一个人。

sentences.en: So a simple move here is to just wipe your phone or throw your phone in a lake and get a new one and start from scratch, and you'll really be able to notice the threat response.
sentences.zh: 所以一个简单的做法是，直接清空你的手机，或者把你的手机扔进湖里，换一部新的，从零开始，这样你就能真切地注意到那种威胁反应。

sentences.en: Then we'll.
sentences.zh: 然后你就会想。

sentences.en: Oh, what about all my contacts?
sentences.zh: 哦，那我所有的联系人怎么办？

sentences.en: What about all my apps? What about all my accounts?
sentences.zh: 我所有的应用怎么办？我所有的账号怎么办？

sentences.en: It's like you're so tied to these things, and you should be in many cases, like, I would do the same thing.
sentences.zh: 就好像你被这些东西绑得死死的，而且在很多情况下你确实应该这样，换我也会一样。

sentences.en: I'd be like, I wouldn't know what to do if my phone just randomly got lost.
sentences.zh: 我会想，如果我的手机突然丢了，我根本不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: Actually, right now that's happened to me before.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这事在我身上发生过。

sentences.en: And the last time it happened, the last time I had to actually switch my phone, I really wanted to.
sentences.zh: 上一次发生这种事，上一次我不得不换手机的时候，我其实特别想这么做。

sentences.en: I just started from a clean slate.
sentences.zh: 我就是从一张白板开始的。

sentences.en: If people needed to contact me, they would contact me.
sentences.zh: 如果有人需要联系我，他们会联系到我。

sentences.en: If I needed to contact people, I'd figure out a way to do so.
sentences.zh: 如果我需要联系别人，我也会想办法联系上。

sentences.en: If I needed something, I'd get it.
sentences.zh: 我需要什么，我就去搞到。

sentences.en: But if you decide to do this, wipe your phone only, download what's necessary.
sentences.zh: 但如果你决定这么做，只把手机清空，只下载必要的东西。

sentences.en: Do just that.
sentences.zh: 就只做这些。

sentences.en: If you need to do something, then do it.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要做某件事，那就去做。

sentences.en: Go through the friction of doing it.
sentences.zh: 去经历做这件事的摩擦。

sentences.en: Don't make it this easily accessible thing.
sentences.zh: 别把它变成一个随手可得的东西。

sentences.en: On a side note there, I just hate the fact that anyone can get Ahold of you nowadays.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我就是讨厌现在谁都能联系到你这件事。

sentences.en: Like literally anyone can just like text you, message you or email you or do whatever that shouldn't happen.
sentences.zh: 真的，随便什么人都能给你发短信、发消息、发邮件，或者干别的什么，这不应该发生。

sentences.en: Like we're not wired for that.
sentences.zh: 我们天生就不是为这个设计的。

sentences.en: So if I don't respond to an email that you send, that's why personally, I think that social media should abolish the comment section, not because there aren't good comments, but because that's the most toxic part of social media where people go and identify with things so strongly, like people don't even have a chance to form their own opinion because they're just bombarded from all angles.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我没回你发的邮件，这就是原因。我个人认为，社交媒体应该废除评论区，不是因为那里没有好评论，而是因为那是社交媒体最毒的部分，人们在那里对事物产生强烈的认同，人们甚至没有机会形成自己的观点，因为他们被来自四面八方的信息轰炸。

sentences.en: And now maybe we shouldn't abolish the comment section itself, but like, something needs to happen and most people can't handle themselves in the comment section.
sentences.zh: 也许我们不该废除评论区本身，但总得发生点什么，大多数人在评论区里根本管不住自己。

sentences.en: I'm not talking about my comment section, but when I look at comment section, it's very entertaining because it's just a fucking war zone.
sentences.zh: 我不是在说我的评论区，但当我看评论区的时候，它非常娱乐，因为那简直就是一个他妈的交战区。

sentences.en: Now, aside from wiping your phone, another difficult thing that a lot of successful people do is they just take a sabbatical.
sentences.zh: 现在，除了清空手机，很多成功人士做的另一件难事就是直接休个长假。

sentences.en: They just go for a week, often to the woods, or they rent an Airbnb at this remote location, just them themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们就去一周，通常是去树林里，或者在一个偏远的地方租个 Airbnb，就他们自己。

sentences.en: All they bring is their laptop.
sentences.zh: 他们只带笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: A lot of creatives do this if they want to actually restart their creativity and have better ideas for something important that they're working on, like if they're writing a book.
sentences.zh: 很多创意工作者如果想真正重启自己的创造力，为正在做的重要事情想出更好的点子，比如写书的时候，就会这么做。

sentences.en: But this is something that you can do to immediately just remove yourself from your environment and form new habits and behaviors.
sentences.zh: 但这是你可以做的事情，让你立刻把自己从当前环境中抽离出来，形成新的习惯和行为。

sentences.en: Now, beyond that, if you want to change your life fast, the most useful thing you can do is immerse your mind in the environment of your future self.
sentences.zh: 现在，除此之外，如果你想快速改变生活，你能做的最有用的事，就是把你的心智沉浸在未来自我的环境中。

sentences.en: Bathe your psyche in the opinions, beliefs, and education that person would have without judgment.
sentences.zh: 用那个人会有的观点、信念和教育来浸泡你的心灵，不加评判。

sentences.en: So when I was first getting started in business, I was just curious about business, right?
sentences.zh: 我刚接触商业的时候，我只是对商业感到好奇，对吧？

sentences.en: I didn't know where to start.
sentences.zh: 我不知道从哪里开始。

sentences.en: I didn't know where to learn. I didn't know what kind of business to start.
sentences.zh: 我不知道去哪里学。我不知道该开始做什么类型的生意。

sentences.en: And I searched for courses and I took a few and they didn't really make sense.
sentences.zh: 我搜了一些课程，也上了几门，但它们真的讲不通。

sentences.en: It's like like I took a digital marketing course and it taught me about MailChimp and other things, and I'm like, what do I do with this?
sentences.zh: 比如我上了一门数字营销课，它教我 MailChimp 和其他东西，我就想，我学这个干什么？

sentences.en: Like, I don't know if that makes sense to you guys now, but like, as someone who knew nothing prior, it's like, why am I learning MailChimp?
sentences.zh: 我不知道你们现在能不能理解，但作为一个之前一无所知的人，就会想，我为什么要学 MailChimp？

sentences.en: What do you mean, emails?
sentences.zh: 你说邮件是什么意思？

sentences.en: What do you mean lead magnet? I have to do this stuff. For what?
sentences.zh: 你说引流磁铁是什么意思？我得做这些事。为了什么？

sentences.en: It just didn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 就是讲不通。

sentences.en: So it wasn't until everything that I read, every video that I watched, every person that I followed online, and all of the conversations I had revolved around business and starting a business.
sentences.zh: 所以直到我读的每样东西、看的每个视频、在网上关注的每个人，以及我进行的所有对话，都围绕着商业和创业。

sentences.en: That's the best way to learn.
sentences.zh: 这才是最好的学习方式。

sentences.en: A course is very useful for learning structure knowledge, but the ins and outs and the opinions, all of the different angles, are best learned by just like diving into a new environment where that's all there is.
sentences.zh: 课程对于学习结构化知识非常有用，但那些细节、观点、所有不同的角度，最好的学习方式就是直接跳进一个新环境，那里只有这些东西。

sentences.en: That's the beautiful thing about modern living today.
sentences.zh: 这就是现代生活美妙的地方。

sentences.en: In the past, you're just in your little tribe.
sentences.zh: 过去，你只能待在自己的小部落里。

sentences.en: Today, you can pick and choose.
sentences.zh: 今天，你可以自己挑选。

sentences.en: You can become anything that you want to because you can just plop yourself in the environment, deal with the discomfort, and you'll want to become that person because memes replicate.
sentences.zh: 你可以成为任何你想成为的人，因为你只需要把自己丢进那个环境里，承受不适，然后你就会想成为那个人——因为模因会复制。

sentences.en: They want to survive.
sentences.zh: 它们想要存活下去。

sentences.en: So I would pick up tips and tricks from the videos, the books, the whatever.
sentences.zh: 所以我会从视频、书籍、各种地方学到技巧和方法。

sentences.en: But more importantly, in this environment, if I wasn't building a business, I didn't fit into the environment.
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，在这个环境里，如果我不在构建一个生意，我就跟这个环境格格不入。

sentences.en: And so that felt wrong.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就是不对。

sentences.en: And so inadvertently, I started a business so I could fit in.
sentences.zh: 于是不知不觉中，我为了融入而开始了一个生意。

sentences.en: So identity is created through learning.
sentences.zh: 所以身份是通过学习创造出来的。

sentences.en: That's like the lesson.
sentences.zh: 这就是核心的一课。

sentences.en: But the thing is that you're not learning if you're just reacting all the time or think you know everything, so you're not actually absorbing all of the information.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，如果你一直在被动反应，或者觉得自己什么都懂，那你根本就没有在学习，你并没有真正吸收那些信息。

sentences.en: So you must willingly expose yourself to perspectives that you disagree with and try to understand why they are right now.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须主动让自己接触那些你不同意的观点，并试着去理解为什么它们是对的。

sentences.en: The fourth pattern here is that you need to increase the gap between impulse and response.
sentences.zh: 这里的第四个模式是：你需要拉长冲动和回应之间的间隙。

sentences.en: And there is a meme going around, a meme, an actual a not actual meme on social media was going around where the background audio was like, like, break the pattern today or you repeat the loop tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 最近有个模因在流传，一个模因，不是社交媒体上那种真正的模因，背景音频大概是这样的：今天打破模式，否则明天你就会重复这个循环。

sentences.en: And it was some like motivational thing.
sentences.zh: 就是那种励志类的东西。

sentences.en: So that's kind of what this is.
sentences.zh: 这大概就是这个意思。

sentences.en: Break the pattern today or you'll repeat the loop tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 今天打破模式，否则明天你就会重复这个循环。

sentences.en: But the way that you detach from old patterns is to do nothing.
sentences.zh: 但让你从旧模式中脱离出来的方法，是什么都不做。

sentences.en: You increase the gap, because doing nothing is the only way that you can interrupt the survival mechanism in real time.
sentences.zh: 你拉长那个间隙，因为什么都不做是唯一能实时打断生存机制的方法。

sentences.en: Everything else, from finding a reason to changing your environment, happens outside the moment of the urge to remain your past self.
sentences.zh: 其他一切，从找到一个理由到改变你的环境，都发生在那个想要维持过去自我的冲动时刻之外。

sentences.en: Those things create better conditions, but they don't help you.
sentences.zh: 那些东西能创造更好的条件，但它们帮不了你。

sentences.en: In the three seconds when your hand is reaching for your phone and you can think of everything like you don't even notice it.
sentences.zh: 在那三秒钟里，当你的手伸向手机，而你可以思考一切——你甚至都注意不到这个过程。

sentences.en: It's not just your phone, it's everything.
sentences.zh: 不只是你的手机，是一切。

sentences.en: It's yourself.
sentences.zh: 是你自己。

sentences.en: So your job is to starve the old self that is trying to survive of the normal feedback it receives.
sentences.zh: 所以你的任务是，让那个试图存活下去的旧自我，得不到它习惯接收的反馈。

sentences.en: And of course, this is a difficult practice, but you must observe and examine yourself throughout the day.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是一个困难的练习，但你必须在一天中观察和审视自己。

sentences.en: Are you just repeating yesterday on autopilot?
sentences.zh: 你是不是在自动驾驶，重复着昨天？

sentences.en: When you read an opinion or belief, are you going to solidify your own stance further by arguing with them in your head and saying how wrong they are?
sentences.zh: 当你读到一个观点或信念时，你是不是在脑子里跟对方争论、说他们错得有多离谱，以此来进一步固化自己的立场？

sentences.en: So when you sit with this uncomfortable feeling without making a decision, you train your nervous system to tolerate the gap between impulse and action.
sentences.zh: 所以当你坐在这股不舒服的感觉里，不做任何决定时，你就是在训练你的神经系统，去承受冲动和行动之间的那个间隙。

sentences.en: From that neutral state, it's much easier to make a conscious choice in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 从那个中立状态出发，做出一个朝向正确方向的清醒选择，会容易得多。

sentences.en: Now, there are plenty of ways to train this gap.
sentences.zh: 训练这个间隙的方法有很多。

sentences.en: What I'm telling you here is something that's already been said many times before.
sentences.zh: 我现在告诉你的，是已经被说过很多次的东西。

sentences.en: There are very popular ways to train this gap, but they become popularized and kind of bastardized from what they're supposed to be.
sentences.zh: 有一些非常流行的训练这个间隙的方法，但它们被普及之后，某种程度上被曲解了，偏离了它们本来的样子。

sentences.en: So there's meditation, there's cold showers or cold exposure, there's fasting, etc. but those things have become religions.
sentences.zh: 比如冥想、冷水澡或冷暴露、断食等等，但这些东西已经变成了宗教。

sentences.en: That's the exact opposite of what we're trying to accomplish here.
sentences.zh: 那跟我们在这里想要达成的目标完全相反。

sentences.en: So anything that helps you delay gratification is useful.
sentences.zh: 所以，任何能帮助你延迟满足的事情，都是有用的。

sentences.en: But just don't join the religion of doing the thing.
sentences.zh: 但别把做某件事搞成一种宗教。

sentences.en: Like you don't have to have an opinion on whether or not cold showers are good or bad.
sentences.zh: 你不需要对冷水澡是好是坏有什么看法。

sentences.en: They're just a tool for increasing the gap between impulse and response.
sentences.zh: 它只是一个拉长冲动和反应之间距离的工具。

sentences.en: But outside of all of those things, I don't think you need to do any of those aside for meditation, but like, that's what I'm trying to say here.
sentences.zh: 但除了冥想，我觉得这些你都不需要做，不过这就是我想说的重点。

sentences.en: The most impactful thing you can do is to practice some kind of a 24 over seven meditation.
sentences.zh: 你能做的最有影响力的事，就是练习一种全天候的冥想。

sentences.en: You have to become the observer of the self that's trying to survive you.
sentences.zh: 你必须成为那个试图让你活不下去的自我的观察者。

sentences.en: You try to operate from a higher level of mind, from a more expanded level.
sentences.zh: 你试着从一个更高层次的心智去运作，从一个更开阔的层面。

sentences.en: You attempt to get really good at that, at expanding and contracting your mind, because that's what it can do.
sentences.zh: 你试着把这件事练好，就是扩展和收缩你的心智，因为它本来就能做到这一点。

sentences.en: You can zoom out very far.
sentences.zh: 你可以把视角拉得非常远。

sentences.en: You can hold a lot of ideas at once, and then you can zoom in and you can work and you can get in the flow state.
sentences.zh: 你可以同时容纳很多想法，然后你又能聚焦，去工作，进入心流状态。

sentences.en: And it's like creativity and productivity and it's a spectrum.
sentences.zh: 这就像创造力和生产力，它是一个光谱。

sentences.en: And you expand and contract between it.
sentences.zh: 你在这之间扩展和收缩。

sentences.en: And the further you can expand and the deeper you can contract in that contraction, you can get more focused work done, more deep conversations done.
sentences.zh: 你扩展得越远，收缩得越深，在那个收缩里，你就能完成更专注的工作，进行更深入的对话。

sentences.en: You're zooming into reality right here, right now.
sentences.zh: 你正在聚焦到此时此地的现实。

sentences.en: What's the task that I'm working on?
sentences.zh: 我正在做的任务是什么？

sentences.en: The expansion is like it's you probably felt it before and it's just like training a muscle, right?
sentences.zh: 扩展就像……你可能以前感受过，它就像训练一块肌肉，对吧？

sentences.en: You expand and contract concentric.
sentences.zh: 你向心和离心，扩展和收缩。

sentences.en: That's how you build the muscle.
sentences.zh: 这就是你练出那块肌肉的方式。

sentences.en: But the problem here is that most people just live in a perpetually zoomed in state.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，大多数人永远活在一个持续聚焦的状态里。

sentences.en: We call it survival mode.
sentences.zh: 我们称之为生存模式。

sentences.en: So the goal here is to just notice it, do nothing about it, and then neutralize the impulse.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的目标就是觉察它，什么也不做，然后中和那个冲动。

sentences.en: You kind of wait until the calm has arrived, and then you make your own decision in the direction you want to go.
sentences.zh: 你等一等，直到平静到来，然后你朝着自己想去的方向，做出自己的决定。

sentences.en: You make your own choice.
sentences.zh: 你做出自己的选择。

sentences.en: So that's kind of how you can weaponize your survival as you start to identify as the person you want to become, you put yourself in that environment.
sentences.zh: 这就是你如何把生存本能变成武器，当你开始认同你想成为的那个人，你就把自己放进那个环境里。

sentences.en: You reprogram your mind so that naturally, almost automatically, you start just doing the actions that are going to make you that person.
sentences.zh: 你重新编程你的大脑，这样它就会自然地、几乎自动地，开始去做那些会让你成为那个人的行动。

sentences.en: But the thing here is that you're still playing the game.
sentences.zh: 但这里的问题是，你仍然在玩这个游戏。

sentences.en: You're still going to be stuck in this kind of cycle of suffering.
sentences.zh: 你仍然会被困在这种受苦的循环里。

sentences.en: So that leads to the last section.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了最后一部分。

sentences.en: And the most important section is that winning the game is how you discover it's the wrong game.
sentences.zh: 而最重要的一部分是：赢得游戏，是你发现它是个错误游戏的方式。

sentences.en: So we'll start with this.
sentences.zh: 所以我们从这里开始。

sentences.en: The greatest trait you can acquire is to work with tremendous intensity on the things that matter to you and more importantly, be strangely bothered when those things don't work out.
sentences.zh: 你能获得的最伟大的特质，就是以极大的强度去投入对你重要的事，更重要的是，当那些事没做成时，你会感到一种奇怪的困扰。

sentences.en: So if you're smart, you've noticed just that, that we've replaced one survival game with another, meaning we replaced one source of suffering with another.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你够聪明，你已经注意到了，我们只是用一个生存游戏替换了另一个，意思是我们用一种受苦的源头替换了另一种。

sentences.en: Because sure, learning how to stress yourself into becoming a hyper successful businessman or building an esthetic physique is better, in my opinion, than stressing yourself into this endless loop of stress of being overweight and broke.
sentences.zh: 因为当然，在我看来，学会给自己施压，成为一个超级成功的商人，或者练出完美的身材，比起给自己施压，陷入超重和破产的无尽压力循环要好。

sentences.en: But the problem is this the business owner will be unhappy until they hit a certain level of money, like $100 million.
sentences.zh: 但问题是：那个企业主在赚到某个数额的钱之前，比如一亿美元，是不会快乐的。

sentences.en: But even once they hit that number, they still have the same identity.
sentences.zh: 但即使他们真的达到了那个数字，他们的身份认同还是老样子。

sentences.en: So if they don't increase that amount the money and continue working, they will remain unhappy.
sentences.zh: 所以如果不继续提高那个金额、继续工作，他们就会一直不快乐。

sentences.en: It's the same old story when someone is working at a startup or a corporation or building a business for most of their life, and then they sell the business for a huge payout.
sentences.zh: 这跟那个老掉牙的故事一模一样：有人在创业公司、大公司或者自己创业干了大半辈子，然后把公司卖了，拿到一大笔钱。

sentences.en: They have this existential crisis.
sentences.zh: 他们陷入了存在主义危机。

sentences.en: They're like, I don't know what to do with my time. I'm depressed.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，我不知道该怎么打发时间，我很抑郁。

sentences.en: I have all this money, but it's not making me happy.
sentences.zh: 我有了这么多钱，但它并没有让我快乐。

sentences.en: But that's kind of the thing, is that you kind of have to experience it before you can transcend it.
sentences.zh: 但问题就在这，有些东西你必须亲身经历过，才能超越它。

sentences.en: And the same thing happens for, let's say, a bodybuilder here, I'm using health and business as like major examples, because that's a lot of my life.
sentences.zh: 同样的事情也会发生在，比如说，一个健美运动员身上。我用健康和商业作为主要例子，因为这两块占据了我生活很大一部分。

sentences.en: So the bodybuilder, as an example, won't be happy until they get their pro card because that's their goal.
sentences.zh: 拿健美运动员来说，他们在拿到职业卡之前不会快乐，因为那是他们的目标。

sentences.en: But unless they have a shift in who they are, they will continue moving the goalpost until they have that existential crisis and they're forced to change after a period of deep depression.
sentences.zh: 但除非他们的自我认知发生转变，否则他们会一直把目标往后挪，直到撞上存在主义危机，经历一段深度抑郁之后，才被迫改变。

sentences.en: And so this is a crucial piece that so many people are missing, is like, you think you want the lives of the business and fitness influencers on social media.
sentences.zh: 这就是一个很多人缺失的关键认知：你以为你想要社交媒体上那些商业和健身博主的生活。

sentences.en: But if you look a bit closer, you can see very clearly that they are covering up their lack of fulfillment with more work.
sentences.zh: 但如果你凑近一点看，能很清楚地发现，他们是在用更多的工作来掩盖自己内心的空虚。

sentences.en: So the goal then is to play the survival game, because there is a great deal of fulfillment that comes from continuous growth, and life is a bitch if you stagnate.
sentences.zh: 所以目标应该是：去玩这场生存游戏，因为持续成长确实能带来巨大的满足感，而如果你停滞不前，生活就是个婊子。

sentences.en: But you must also transcend the game.
sentences.zh: 但你也必须超越这场游戏。

sentences.en: You must also remain largely unbothered when things don't work out.
sentences.zh: 当事情不如意时，你也必须基本上不为所动。

sentences.en: So the question then is how does one become unbothered?
sentences.zh: 那么问题来了：一个人怎样才能变得不为所动？

sentences.en: And the hard thing there is that you can't try to be unbothered.
sentences.zh: 而困难的地方在于，你没法"努力"去变得不为所动。

sentences.en: You can't try to be cool and lax because the bothered self attempting to become the unbothered self is just another survival strategy.
sentences.zh: 你没法"努力"去变得酷、变得松弛，因为那个"会被扰动"的自我，试图变成"不为所动"的自我，这本身只是另一种生存策略。

sentences.en: The person who says I'm going to detach from outcomes has just made not being attached to outcomes the outcome they're attached to, so it becomes the axis of their suffering.
sentences.zh: 那个说"我要放下对结果的执着"的人，只是把"不执着于结果"变成了他执着的新结果，于是这成了他痛苦的轴心。

sentences.en: This is like a huge spiritual trap.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的灵性陷阱。

sentences.en: It's like you read one spirituality book and then you kind of you see that and you're like, This is like a higher form of being.
sentences.zh: 就像你读了一本灵修书，然后你看到了那种境界，心想：这是一种更高层次的存在状态。

sentences.en: If I just act like I'm that person, then people will perceive me as this, like high and wise person.
sentences.zh: 只要我表现得像那个人，别人就会觉得我是个高人、一个智者。

sentences.en: But you haven't put in the years of work to naturally become that.
sentences.zh: 但你并没有投入多年的功夫去自然地成为那样的人。

sentences.en: And that's the big trap. It's premature. Transcendent.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个巨大的陷阱。这是早熟的超越。

sentences.en: So I kind of just yanked your tail this entire video, and I was kind of hesitant to put this section in the video, because what most people want on YouTube and in content is just like, give me the actual strategy.
sentences.zh: 所以这整支视频我基本上都在拽你的尾巴，而且我本来有点犹豫要不要把这一段放进来，因为大多数人在 YouTube 和内容里想要的只是：给我具体的策略。

sentences.en: Give me the give me the cheap dopamine hit.
sentences.zh: 给我廉价的、多巴胺式的快感。

sentences.en: Now give me the higher form of the cheap dopamine hit by watching a video that promises them a lot of success so they can feel as if they know more than the other person, or they can feel as if they're making progress when they really aren't.
sentences.zh: 现在再给我一种更高级的廉价多巴胺快感：看一个承诺巨大成功的视频，这样他们就能感觉自己比别人懂得多，或者感觉自己正在进步，而实际上并没有。

sentences.en: Because in relation to this video, most people have to be deeply attached to something before their attachment becomes visible enough to see through.
sentences.zh: 因为就这支视频而言，大多数人必须先深深地执着于某样东西，直到那份执着变得足够显眼，才能被看穿。

sentences.en: Right? There is no quick fix to that.
sentences.zh: 对吧？这没有速效药。

sentences.en: What you can do, however, for the sake of giving you something to do, is this.
sentences.zh: 不过，为了让你有点事可做，你可以试试这个。

sentences.en: First, just continue increasing the gap between impulse and response.
sentences.zh: 第一，继续拉大冲动和回应之间的间隙。

sentences.en: Work your psychic muscle, expand and contract the mind and be aware of it.
sentences.zh: 锻炼你的心灵肌肉，扩张和收缩你的意识，并觉察这个过程。

sentences.en: Become very familiar with what those states of consciousness feel like.
sentences.zh: 去深度熟悉那些意识状态到底是什么感觉。

sentences.en: Second, distinguish pain from suffering.
sentences.zh: 第二，区分疼痛和痛苦。

sentences.en: Pain is a feature of life.
sentences.zh: 痛苦是人生的标配。

sentences.en: Suffering is the identities. Refusal to accept the event.
sentences.zh: 苦难是你给自己加的身份，是拒绝接受事实。

sentences.en: Becoming more conscious and open minded doesn't remove pain, but it removes the second layer.
sentences.zh: 变得更清醒、更开放，不会消除痛苦，但会消除第二层折磨。

sentences.en: The businessman whose revenue drop still feels the punch, but he doesn't have to feel the subsequent spiral of this shouldn't be happening to me.
sentences.zh: 那个收入下滑的商人，依然会感到冲击，但他不必再经历"这种事不该发生在我身上"的后续螺旋。

sentences.en: I feel like a failure.
sentences.zh: 我是个失败者。

sentences.en: My life is ruined.
sentences.zh: 我的人生毁了。

sentences.en: The intense and unbothered personality is powerful.
sentences.zh: 那种极度专注、不受干扰的人格，力量极其强大。

sentences.en: It is near the pinnacle of human development across both material and spiritual planes.
sentences.zh: 它接近人类发展的顶峰，横跨物质与精神两个层面。

sentences.en: They are a walking contradiction.
sentences.zh: 他们是行走的矛盾体。

sentences.en: They fear mediocrity enough to work hard, and they're unbothered enough to not collapse when things don't work out, it is the mark of a mature mind to be able to hold two opposing forces at once.
sentences.zh: 他们足够恐惧平庸，所以拼命努力；又足够不受干扰，所以事情不成也不会崩溃。能同时容纳两股对立的力量，是成熟心智的标志。

sentences.en: I hope that you are able to one day master that state until then.
sentences.zh: 我希望你有一天能掌握那种状态。在那之前——

sentences.en: Thank you for watching.
sentences.zh: 感谢观看。

sentences.en: If I were to pitch one thing to you, it would be the paid version of my Substack, which is a library of AI prompts writing strategies.
sentences.zh: 如果让我向你推荐一样东西，那就是我 Substack 的付费版，它是一个 AI 提示词和写作策略的图书馆。

sentences.en: When I say writing strategies, it's mostly like, how do you take your ideas and put it into a form that other people want to read, watch, study.
sentences.zh: 我说的写作策略，主要是：你怎么把你的想法，转化成别人愿意读、愿意看、愿意研究的形式。

sentences.en: Because if you're pursuing your life's work, you need to attract people to your life's work.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你在追求你一生的事业，你就需要吸引人们到你的事业中来。

sentences.en: So that's kind of what it is. And then marketing strategies.
sentences.zh: 大概就是这个意思。还有营销策略。

sentences.en: So how do you actually take what, you know, package it up into something valuable and get paid for it?
sentences.zh: 也就是你怎么把你有的东西，打包成有价值的东西，并靠它获得收入。

sentences.en: And I recently added on, I'm going to be doing monthly live streams of breaking down other successful people creators.
sentences.zh: 我最近还加了一项：我会做月度直播，拆解其他成功的创作者。

sentences.en: They're going to be coming on.
sentences.zh: 他们会来做客。

sentences.en: So Max Bernstein just came on before I released this video, and he went over his cognitive fingerprint, which is meant for people who feel like they have nothing to say or feel like they don't have ideas worth putting out into the world.
sentences.zh: 在我发布这个视频之前，Max Bernstein 刚来过，他讲了他的"认知指纹"，这是为那些觉得自己没什么可说、或者觉得自己没有值得分享的想法的人准备的。

sentences.en: And what Max does is, with the help of AI, is to help uncover the things that you do have to say, and you just can't find them because they're stuck inside of your head.
sentences.zh: Max 做的是，借助 AI，帮你挖掘出你其实有、只是找不到的东西，因为它们卡在你脑子里了。

sentences.en: So if you're interested, join that.
sentences.zh: 如果你感兴趣，就加入吧。

sentences.en: There may or may not be a discount in the link in the description just for people who finished the video.
sentences.zh: 简介链接里可能有折扣，也可能没有，只给看完视频的人。

sentences.en: But aside from that, like and subscribe.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，点赞、订阅。

sentences.en: I'll see you in the next video. Bye.
sentences.zh: 下个视频见。拜。
